$comment: Neutral, agent-agnostic MCP server definitions. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH. Add a server here and run bootstrap: it propagates to every client (Kiro, Cline, Goose). bin/gen-mcp.py merges these into each client's native config, replacing only the custom MCP servers and preserving everything else (Goose builtins, providers, etc.). Do NOT hand-edit the generated client configs. No secrets: aws-mcp authenticates via AWS SSO using the named profile below, resolved at runtime.
